verdict.rationale: The EIN online assistant is the founder's core online flow. Its published page describes a single session with no save that "expires after 15 minutes of inactivity" and must be restarted, plus a per-responsible-party daily limit and a third-party designee path. That points to a keyless, session-based entry, but none of the cited content says outright that no account is needed. The other online rails are explicitly account-gated: signed mobile-friendly forms such as Form 15620 require Online Account behind ID.me biometric sign-in, and the online 83(b) entry returned 403 to a keyless probe. Missing for 10: an explicit published statement that the EIN assistant needs no account or ID.me sign-in; a documented keyless or file-number entry for other core flows such as 83(b) or signed forms; independent or hands-on confirmation of account-free EIN entry.
